description.value: The study examined metacognitive accuracy and its association with gray matter volume in active and remitted cocaine use disorder compared with healthy controls.

spans.text: In the present study, we tested for metacognitive deficits in individuals with CUD using a basic visuo-perceptual task.

value: We hypothesized that CUD participants, particularly active/recent users of cocaine, would display impairments in basic metacognitive accuracy, which in turn would be associated with gray matter volume (GMV) decreases in the aPFC.
